how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:seasonal-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1657:obj:0: Toss three ⟦E1⟧ Stink Bombs into the heart of ⟦E2⟧ in Hillsbrad, and return to Darkcaller Yanka at the Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade.
rows.quest:1657:details:0: Celebrate Hallow's End in style... by bringing grief to our enemies in ⟦E2⟧!
rows.quest:1657:details:1: BTake one of these specially crafted stink bombs. It is filled with an odiferous funk that no human - or any weak-willed beast for that matter - can stand to smell. You'll need to throw it right in the heart of ⟦E2⟧ for it to do its job, so be prepared for a fight against the ⟦E3⟧!
rows.quest:1657:details:2: BWhen you've completed this task... this tribute to our liberation, return to me!
rows.quest:1657:completion:0: Ah, well done! I hope the ⟦E3⟧ chokes on the foul gift we've given them, much like we were forced to choke on the yoke of enslavement to the Scourge!
rows.quest:1657:completion:1: BYou've kept the ideas of Hallow's End true, ⟦1⟧, and for that I salute you. As an extra bonus, let me share some of these Hallow's End treats I have with you. I think you might find them to be quite the enjoyable diversion!
rows.quest:1658:obj:0: Locate the ⟦E1⟧'s Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade. Return to Sergeant Hartman in ⟦E2⟧ once you've done so.
rows.quest:1658:details:0: I need brave individuals to head up to Tirisfal Glade and check out the Wickerman Festival. I'm not going to lie - heading up there will be dangerous. The guards at the festival will be exceptionally vicious. Still, we need to know how big the festival is this year, and how much trouble the ⟦E1⟧ are going to cause us during Hallow's End.
rows.quest:1658:details:1: BIf you're up for it, head to Tirisfal and scout out the festival. Return to me with the information, and I'll make sure you're well compensated.
rows.quest:1658:completion:0: Well done, ⟦2⟧. The Wickerman Festival will continue to be trouble so long as the abominable ⟦E1⟧ are allowed to haunt the remnants of Lordaeron. It is NOT a fitting tribute to that once proud kingdom, let me tell you...
rows.quest:1658:completion:1: BHere's some coin for any repairs you might need, and in the spirit of the season I've also included some treats you might like. Happy Hallow's End - let's keep it as safe as possible here in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:6961:obj:0: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:6961:details:0: Have a wondrous Winter Veil, friend! Be sure to say hello to Greatfather Winter! If you've been nice this year, you'll receive wondrous treats on the day of the Feast of Winter Veil. Be sure to tell him what you hope to get this year!
rows.quest:6961:details:1: BAlso, be sure to stock up on treats to give those who've been nice this year. We have a great selection to choose from. Fresh from our farm to your plate - it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness!
rows.quest:6961:completion:0: Ho ho hello. I am Greatfather Winter, and I - courtesy of the fine folks of Smokywood Pastures... "Fresh from our farm to your plate, it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness" - would like to wish you a fantastic Feast of Winter Veil.
rows.quest:6961:completion:1: BIf you've been good this year, maybe you will receive treats from Smokywood Pastures as your treat for the Feast of Winter Veil. Huzzah.
rows.quest:6962:obj:0: Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Great-father Winter in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:6962:details:0: Hey, can you do Great-father Winter a favor, um, little ⟦3⟧?
rows.quest:6962:details:1: BNot to needlessly talk about myself in the third person, but Great-father Winter has been at this all day and he could use a treat himself. Some gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk to wash them down with would really hit the spot. Think you could be a friend to the Great-father and fetch some for me?
rows.quest:6962:completion:0: You're quite the helper to ol' Great-father Winter there, ⟦4⟧. Have a great Feast of Winter Veil.
rows.quest:6962:completion:1: BHere's a little something... you know, for the effort.
rows.quest:6963:obj:0: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:6963:details:0: Listen... not to shatter the magic of the season here, but Smokywood Pastures could use some assistance - the kind you adventuring types are known to give.
rows.quest:6963:details:1: BWe're missing an important shipment of treats that was restocking us for the season, and now we're missing the agent of Smokywood Pastures that we sent out to the field to find it! Please - the shipment was last reported in the ⟦E5⟧, and that's where our man went to look for it.
rows.quest:6963:details:2: BSee if both are out there, safe and sound!
rows.quest:6963:completion:0: Y-y-you can h-h-hear me! Thank the b-b-bottom line!
rows.quest:6963:completion:1: BI'm not really a s-s-snowman - my n-n-name is Sacks, and I w-w-work for the ⟦E4⟧ b-b-branch of Smokywood Pastures... I g-g-got sent out here to look for a m-m-missing package, when I was attacked by a c-c-creature I have never seen b-b-before!
rows.quest:6964:obj:0: Speak with Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom of ⟦E4⟧ about the Feast of Winter Veil.
rows.quest:6964:details:0: Gifts, treats, presents... bah, I say!
rows.quest:6964:details:1: BThose goblins pollute the true meaning of this season - the Feast of Winter Veil. This is a time of renewal; the land slumbers under a blanket of snow brought forth by Greatfather Winter, who is NOT the bumbling fool over there in the red suit!
rows.quest:6964:details:2: BIf you're interested in learning what the Feast is all about for yourself, ask Sagorne Creststrider. I'm sure he'll be surprised that someone cares about history rather than getting presents.
rows.quest:6964:completion:0: The Feast of Winter Veil, you say? Alas, in times past it held a more substantial meaning to us tauren. Nowadays, it seems as though others have turned the legend of this season of renewal into something that helps to sell candies and presents.
rows.quest:6964:completion:1: BIt's no surprise that Furmund is bitter about that sort of change. He and other tauren like him cling to our past like a banner of war. While I think a little celebration is always good, it is important to remember the origins of the Feast.
rows.quest:6983:obj:0: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Kaymard Copperpinch in ⟦E4⟧. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:6983:details:0: A c-c-creature called "The Abominable Greench" is the one w-w-who stole our shipment of t-t-treats, ⟦5⟧. Be c-c-careful though! He is t-t-the one who turned me into this s-s-snowy mess!
rows.quest:6983:details:1: BYou're g-g-gonna need some help in f-f-facing him. I've seen him w-w-wander all around where the y-y-yeti are; he's s-s-surely here s-s-somewhere! F-f-find the treats ⟦6⟧, take them b-b-back to Smokywood Pastures in ⟦E4⟧, and t-t-tell them I n-n-need to be unfrozen!
rows.quest:6983:completion:0: You found it! You've saved Smokywood Pasture's Feast of Winter Veil!
rows.quest:6983:completion:1: BPoor Sacks... we'll be sure to send a team out there and figure out a way to unfreeze him. Hopefully, he'll be back in time for the day of the Feast; he'll need to make up missed time working though. Still, this wouldn't even be possible if it weren't for you!
rows.quest:6984:details:0: We at Smokywood Pastures appreciate the recovery of the stolen treats, ⟦7⟧. For that, we'd like to offer you a special gift... presented by none other than Great-father Winter himself!
rows.quest:6984:details:1: BPlease, speak with Great-father Winter, and he will give you your Feast of Winter Veil gift from us here at Smokywood Pastures. From our farm to your plate, it's always Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness... thanks to you, of course!
rows.quest:6984:completion:1: BThe goblins told me that you have earned a special gift this holiday season, and I am pleased to give it to you. Here you go - have a wondrous Feast of Winter Veil this and every season in the future.

rows.quest:7061:obj:0: Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to Cairne Bloodhoof in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:7061:details:0: Here - if you are interested in learning more about the Feast of Winter Veil, read this book. While I think our recognition of the legend is the appropriate one, I'm enough of a student of legends to appreciate the collection of all information into a single source.
rows.quest:7061:details:1: BWhen you're done, take the book to Cairne Bloodhoof in ⟦E7⟧. I know for a fact he'd be interested in hearing that others have taken an interest in the lore of our people.
rows.quest:7061:completion:0: The legends and lore surrounding the Winter Veil are ones that have faded from the forefront of public thought over the years. Yes, I know that the goblins are helping to revive the season for their own ends, the fact that our people reflect upon it at least in some form does good to keep such lore alive.
rows.quest:7061:completion:1: BYour desire to go beyond the material and learn about our past is an admirable trait, young ⟦14⟧. I salute your wisdom.

rows.quest:8149:obj:0: ⟦E8⟧ to Uther's Tomb in ⟦E9⟧ and use Uther's Tribute at his statue, and then return to Wagner Hammerstrike outside ⟦E6⟧ before the Harvest Festival is over.
rows.quest:8149:details:0: During the Harvest Festival of ⟦E10⟧, we give thanks to heroes for the sacrifices - in some cases ultimate sacrifices - they have given on our behalf. The ⟦E3⟧ acknowledges many heroes, but none weave a more tragic tale than that of Uther Lightbringer.
rows.quest:8149:details:1: BHelp us honor Uther by taking this offering to his tomb in the ⟦E9⟧. Place it at his statue, and then return to me. I'll only be here through the end of the festival, so waste no time in giving Uther his tribute.
rows.quest:8149:completion:0: He was a hero among heroes, Uther was. I can't even begin to imagine the anguish of what he felt when ⟦E11⟧ - his greatest student and someone whom Uther loved like his own son - betrayed all of humanity. Still, he rose to try and stop ⟦E11⟧, and for that he will be forever remembered as a true paladin. His fight was to the end, thinking only of those he might save.
rows.quest:8149:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦16⟧. You've paid tribute to a great hero today, honoring his spirit and the spirit of the Harvest Festival.
rows.quest:8150:obj:0: ⟦E8⟧ to Grom's Monument in the Demon Fall Canyon of ⟦E12⟧ and use Grom's Tribute at the base of the monument. Return to Javnir Nashak outside ⟦E4⟧ before the Harvest Festival is over.
rows.quest:8150:details:0: During the Harvest Festival of ⟦E10⟧, we give thanks to heroes for the sacrifices - in some cases ultimate sacrifices - they have given on our behalf. The ⟦E13⟧ acknowledges many heroes, but none exemplify strength and sacrifice more than ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:8150:details:1: BHelp us honor Grom by taking this offering to his monument in the Demon Fall Canyon of ⟦E12⟧. Place it at the base, and then return to me. I'll only be here through the end of the festival, so waste no time in giving Grom his tribute.
rows.quest:8150:completion:0: Grom's full name - Grommash - means "The Giant's Heart"; it took that and more to stand alone against Mannoroth. I think the Warchief said it best when the curse of the orcs began and ended with Grom. Fitting that Grom's sacrifice - and perhaps redemption - would be the wellspring from which the ⟦E13⟧ flows today.
rows.quest:8150:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦17⟧. You've paid tribute to a great hero today, honoring his spirit and the spirit of the Harvest Festival.
rows.quest:8311:obj:0: Speak with the innkeepers of ⟦E15⟧, ⟦E6⟧, and ⟦E16⟧, as well as Talvash del Kissel in ⟦E6⟧. Perform the tricks they ask of you in exchange for the treats they offer.
rows.quest:8311:obj:1: BReturn to Jesper at the ⟦E15⟧ Orphanage with a ⟦E16⟧ Marzipan, Gnomeregan Gumdrop, ⟦E15⟧ Nougat, and ⟦E6⟧ Mint.
rows.quest:8311:details:0: I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick. If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have! I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!
rows.quest:8311:details:1: BEach of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for! Also, a little gnome named Talvash in ⟦E6⟧ is handing out candy as well. When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
rows.quest:8311:completion:0: Wow, you got them all! You're awesome!
rows.quest:8311:completion:1: BThank you for trick-or-treating for me. Here, take these pumpkin treats - I think you'll like them a lot!

rows.quest:8322:obj:0: Place the Rotten Eggs in the main brew keg located inside the ⟦E2⟧ Inn.
rows.quest:8322:details:0: The humans of ⟦E2⟧ love their ale, and as such they prize the ale served at the ⟦E2⟧ Inn. With the chaos of Hallow's End now upon them, we can use it to ruin their latest batch of beverages for weeks - if not months to come!
rows.quest:8322:details:1: BTake these rotten eggs and place them in the main brew keg inside the ⟦E2⟧ Inn. Your presence alone will cause strife, so be prepared to defend yourself!
rows.quest:8322:details:2: BOnce you've given ⟦E2⟧ a taste they'll not soon forget, return to me here at the festival!
rows.quest:8322:completion:0: The keg is filled with ale.
rows.quest:8322:completion:1: BHaving successfully fought your way inside the inn, you now place the eggs inside the keg. You can smell the foul odor permeating the air...
rows.quest:8373:obj:0: Use a Stink Bomb Cleaner to remove any ⟦E1⟧ Stink Bomb that's been dropped on ⟦E2⟧. Return to Sergeant Hartman in ⟦E2⟧ when you're done.
rows.quest:8373:details:0: The thing I hate the most about Hallow's End are the stink bombs the ⟦E1⟧ use on ⟦E2⟧. Who knew that celebrating liberation would have to involve such a smelly mess?
rows.quest:8373:details:1: BDuring Hallow's End, use this cleaner to remove any nasty stink bombs the ⟦E13⟧ may drop here in the village. It uses the power of pine to fight funky smells.
rows.quest:8373:details:2: BDo your part to keep ⟦E2⟧ clean, and I'll give you some Hallow's End treats I'm sure you'll enjoy. We have a deal?
rows.quest:8373:completion:0: Ah, it almost smells better around here already. Almost.
rows.quest:8373:completion:1: BThanks to you, ⟦20⟧, ⟦E2⟧ just might make it through another Hallow's End. Here's your treats, with my thanks! If you run out of candy, I think there's a gnome named Katrina Shimmerstar in ⟦E6⟧ who can sell you more; she's only around during Hallow's End, I believe.
rows.quest:8409:obj:0: Return to Darkcaller Yanka at the Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade.
rows.quest:8409:details:0: The rotten eggs have been successfully placed inside the keg. Future batches of ale from the ⟦E2⟧ Inn are sure to be ruined!
rows.quest:8409:details:1: BYou should now report back to Darkcaller Yanka at the Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade and report your success.
rows.quest:8409:completion:0: Ah, success! You've shown true Hallow's End spirit - FORSAKEN spirit, I should say!
rows.quest:8409:completion:1: B<Darkcaller Yanka laughs and rubs her hands together.>
rows.quest:8409:completion:2: BI revel in the fact that ⟦E2⟧ must now feast on bad ale or go without! As for you, take these treats. I believe you will find good use for them!

rows.quest:8746:obj:0: Find Metzen the Reindeer. Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.
rows.quest:8746:obj:1: BWhen you find Metzen, have the Pouch of Reindeer Dust in your possession so you can sprinkle some of the dust on him; this should free Metzen from his bonds of captivity.
rows.quest:8746:obj:2: BReturn the Pouch of Reindeer Dust to Kaymard Copperpinch in ⟦E4⟧ once Metzen is freed.
rows.quest:8746:details:0: DISASTER has struck! Metzen the Reindeer has been kidnapped!
rows.quest:8746:details:1: BMetzen is one of Great-father Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures. We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen. With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here! Please - find Metzen and return him to us!
rows.quest:8746:details:2: BCheck out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!
rows.quest:8746:completion:1: BMetzen flew back into Great-father Winter's stables - yes Metzen can really fly - just a little while ago! The dust worked like a charm; I knew it would. You've saved the Feast of Winter Veil as well as Smokywood Pastures from disaster. Thank you, ⟦26⟧.
rows.quest:8746:completion:2: BListen... because of what you've done here, I want you to have this. It's something VERY special; if you have a mount, I think you'll get a kick out of it. Happy Winter Veil!

rows.quest:8763:obj:0: Bring 1 Deeprock Salt and 5 gold coins to any Holly Preserver machine, upon which you will receive 5 Preserved Holly.
rows.quest:8763:details:0: Listen... I'm not really supposed to be telling you this, but since you're the hero of the day and all...
rows.quest:8763:details:1: BThere's fresh holly everywhere this time of the year, but it never lasts. We've got a machine that preserves holly - it never goes bad! We use it to spice up the holiday... and profits during the summer!
rows.quest:8763:details:2: BI'll let you use the preserver, but only if you're a master cook. You'll need some deeprock salt and two, three, oh let's say five gold. It'll net you a nice batch that's yours to keep.
rows.quest:8763:completion:0: The machine lets off a little rumble and a small amount of steam as it starts working. It is not too long thereafter until it stops, heralded by another small jet of steam erupting from it. A door hatch opens, revealing a batch of preserved holly!

rows.quest:8827:obj:0: Speak with Greatfather Winter. He is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:8827:details:0: I hear Greatfather Winter - with the generous support of Smokywood Pastures - has put presents for everyone under the tree in ⟦E6⟧. I wish I could go, but I've got to look after the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt.
rows.quest:8827:details:1: BBut you should definitely check it out. I'm sure Greatfather Winter has some presents with your name on them.
rows.quest:8827:completion:0: Oh, ho hello there! You can only be here for one reason: to open your Winter Veil presents.
rows.quest:8827:completion:1: BNow, don't you worry, Greatfather Winter hasn't forgotten about his favorite ⟦43⟧ ⟦44⟧. Look under the tree and you'll find your gifts.

rows.quest:8860:obj:0: Bring the Smokywood Supplies to ⟦E19⟧ Allison in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:8860:details:0: ⟦E15⟧ is holding a celebration for the new year! All day long today you can get free booze, and at night they'll put on a firework show! It should be pretty nice... but Booty Bay is also having a party today; I bet it'll be even better!
rows.quest:8860:details:1: BWell anyway, ⟦E19⟧ Allison in ⟦E15⟧ needs a supply of Smoky Wood Pasture fare to help feed all the party goers. Can you do me a favor and deliver it!
rows.quest:8860:details:2: BThanks, ⟦47⟧! ⟦E19⟧ Allison is in the Gilded Rose, in the Trade District of ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:8860:completion:0: Oh, my Smokywood supplies! Splendid! I'll need these to feed all the people in town for the celebration!
rows.quest:8860:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦48⟧. Please take this as payment, and don't forget to drink and dance with the revelers outside!
